claim: When an unattended headless agent run exits cleanly without its declared result artifact, have the runner resume the same session with a bounded continuation prompt (read the pending process log, finish, write the artifact) instead of adding an instruction line or scoring the run, because headless agents end the whole run when they end a turn "waiting for" a background process, and a prose rule against it did not hold.
because: T-SUN-001 (2026-10-02): a Grok agent backgrounded an engine import, ended its turn to wait, and the run stopped at 37 min with all work uncommitted and the import failing unread. T-TER-005 (2026-10-03, 64 turns): the same failure recurred after the agent guide forbade it. A Gemini fallback did the same on 2026-10-04, so it is not one family. The runner fix, up to two same-session continuations when exit 0 has no REPORT, was verified to keep the session context; the rate at which continuations then produced the artifact was not measured.

claim: When a model judge or perceptual metric scores a candidate render against a reference image, first measure its floor (a known-worse render) and its ceiling (the reference scored against a second reference of the same style), read every score against that ladder, and disqualify the instrument for any frame whose reading falls outside floor..ceiling, because a cross-domain judge can cap below its target and a metric can rate a render past the reference on statistics it merely shares.
because: 2026-10-03: after a material pass the render a human called closest to its reference still scored 2/5 on a blind Gemini judge that cited properties of the photoreal reference the real-time target never had (a judge ceiling, not a render defect). 2026-10-04 (task F1): a ladder with floor = old render and ceiling = reference-vs-reference put the current frame past the ceiling on palette EMD and DISTS, so both metrics were disqualified for that frame instead of being read as a win.
